passive.name: Duelist's Dance
passive.text: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.

spells.name: Lunge
spells.text: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

spells.name: Riposte
spells.text: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

spells.name: Bladework
spells.text: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

spells.name: Grand Challenge
spells.text: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

damage.value: Fiora deals physical damage with Lunge and can burst with Bladework’s critical second attack.

archetype.value: Fiora is a duelist who lunges at enemies and strikes Vitals to restore Health and gain Move Speed.

axis.value: Fiora favors longer trades, using Lunge to chase and Bladework’s slow to keep fighting.

winCondition.value: Fiora can snowball and carry fights into the late game.

spikes.why: Fiora's Lunge can reach about a four-second cooldown when it hits, making it easier for Fiora to keep chasing.
Fiora reduces Lunge’s cooldown by 60%, letting her chase again sooner.

spikes.at: Fiora’s Lunge reaches a 6-second cooldown at rank five
spikes.why: Fiora can lunge and stab more often.

bait.why: Fiora's Riposte has a long cooldown, so spending it improperly leaves Fiora vulnerable.

mistakes.value: Fiora players can misuse Riposte instead of preserving the threat of having it available.
Fiora players often underrate Bladework’s slow, attack speed, and guaranteed second-hit crit.
Fiora wastes Riposte’s chance to stun if she uses it without blocking an immobilizing effect.
